articles.summary: A foot traffic count tells you how many people walked in, not who they were or what they did. Here's why foot traffic alone can't explain store performance.
articles.title: Why Foot Traffic Alone Doesn’t Tell You Anything

articles.summary: Dwell time shows how long shoppers actually spend in front of a product or zone. Here's what dwell time in retail means, and why most stores never use it.
articles.title: What Is Dwell Time in Retail & Why It’s the Metric You’re Not Measuring
